description: This file provides centralized utilities for formatting relative times and timestamps, including functions to format durations as 'x minutes ago' and to format epoch timestamps relative to the current time, with options for fallbacks and date formatting.

methods.name: formatTimeAgo
methods.description: Formats a duration in milliseconds into a human-readable relative time string, e.g., '5m ago' or 'just now'.

methods.name: formatRelativeTimestamp
methods.description: Formats an epoch timestamp relative to the current time, handling past and future, with optional fallback to short date format.
